name: DOCX-aligned fallback scoring with five investor bands

profile_bands.label: Very Conservative
profile_bands.description: The fallback score points strongly toward preserving capital, limiting volatility, and keeping a large stability anchor.

profile_bands.label: Conservative
profile_bands.description: The fallback score supports a cautious allocation with meaningful stability and a limited growth sleeve.

profile_bands.label: Balanced
profile_bands.description: The fallback score supports a mixed allocation that balances stability and growth.

profile_bands.label: Growth
profile_bands.description: The fallback score supports a growth-oriented allocation with a clear equity majority.

profile_bands.label: Aggressive
profile_bands.description: The fallback score supports a strongly growth-oriented allocation with only a small stability allocation.

reason_rules.text: A longer goal horizon generally allows the portfolio more time to recover from market swings.
A shorter goal horizon generally pushes the fallback score toward more stability and lower risk.
High expected withdrawals for major expenses reduce the room to take portfolio risk.
A stronger emergency reserve can support somewhat greater investment risk capacity.
Your stated willingness to take risk suggests the fallback path should stay cautious.
Your stated willingness to take risk supports a more growth-oriented fallback profile.
Your past response to losses suggests lower comfort with drawdowns.
Your past response to losses suggests you may stay more disciplined during volatility.
